populationServed.rationale: EPFO's official indexed overview reports 29.88 crore member accounts and 147 offices across India.

grievanceRelevance.rationale: The official CPGRAMS report ranks the Ministry of Labour and Employment first for Central grievance receipts and identifies EPFO as a major contributor to the ministry's monthly volume.

sourceCompleteness.rationale: Official RTI, directory and office-locator paths exist, but no complete current designation-based CPIO/FAA mapping was verified; two recently indexed pages returned 404 and the locator labels its own data under verification.

filingAccessibility.rationale: Central RTI Online and EPFO office discovery paths exist, but the exact live portal label, record-owning office and complete offline addressee have not been verified.

maintainability.rationale: EPFO maintains an official national locator and directory structure, but current availability failures and the locator's under-verification warning require manual reconstruction and confirmation.

notes: The high numerical score cannot override sourceCompleteness below 3, disputed page availability, decentralized record custody or the official locator's under-verification warning. Do not collect a UAN, Aadhaar number, claim number, employer code or account credentials for authority routing; any user-confirmed case reference stays local and out of logs, diagnostics and fixtures. Filing-ready support requires a current designation-based CPIO/FAA directory and deterministic office-selection rules.
